notes.title: V0.1.1 Armon pass opened and many bugfixes
notes.notes:
- Armon pass opened
- Rock at snowfield pass can be removed
- Big bunch of bugfixes
- New theme now in the start menu!

notes.title: V0.1.0 Snowfield pass ready, start to Armon, bugfixes and new main theme!
notes.notes:
- The snowfield pass is now completely done and the start of armon is set. 
- There is also a new main theme available in the game soon!
- You can now sleep and rest in your own bed (thx to @gldpoet)

notes.title: v0.0.11 Snowfield and cosmetic update
notes.notes: We have added a new map: snowfield and did some cosmetic changes on the game.

notes.title: V0.0.9 Parallax at Momonga & Bugfixes
notes.notes: We have added a parallax background to the Momonga Mountains and did some bugfixes.

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
The villagers of Artcaster decorated the cities for Halloween and the mysterious house is now opened!
The house seems to be harmless but you have to search under every stone and every box to discover the secret!
